metadata.tod_density_mechanism_note: 2.0x the parcel's own existing zoned density -- Honolulu Revised Ordinances section 21-9.100-8's major-TOD-special-district-permit FAR/density multiplier, applied to Kauai's own R-district density_per_acre rule rather than a flat absolute figure borrowed from Honolulu's Iwilei-Kapalama pilot (confirmed, 2026-10-15, to not be a statewide density standard of any kind). Only applies where a density_per_acre figure exists (R-numbered districts); AG/O/CN/CG parcels are excluded, same as elsewhere in this project.
